recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a man in traditional western attire against a flat, desaturated blue-grey background, featuring high-contrast lighting and two distinct horizontal typographic layers across the mid-section.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's dark leather textures contrast against the matte, cool-toned background.
The bright red display text creates a horizontal anchor across the chest area.
The shadow from the hat brim creates a focal point on the eyes and upper face.
The hands-in-pockets pose creates a stable triangular base for the composition.
coreInvariants: Centered vertical symmetry of the subject
High-sheen leather texture on the jacket

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium-shot, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, framed by the dark cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the face down to the bold red text, then following the horizontal line of the text across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial empty space above the hat and to the sides of the torso, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the skin tones and the dark clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool greys, blacks, and one high-chroma accent color

letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Ultra-wide, square-proportioned caps with stencil-like gaps.
Secondary text: Slanted, high-contrast serif with a calligraphic feel.
Integration of a small graphic symbol (lightning bolt) within the secondary text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' and 'L' in the primary text feature horizontal breaks or missing segments.
The 'E' is reduced to three horizontal bars.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a rigid, red geometric display face and a delicate, white italic serif.
graphicDevices: Lightning bolt icon used as a character replacement or accent.

avoid: Script fonts for the primary name

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the square, wide geometric base for the primary text.
Matches the high-contrast serif look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man wearing a black cowboy hat and a black leather jacket, centered against a solid matte slate-blue background. Use dramatic lighting that casts a shadow over the eyes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary text in bright red using an ultra-wide geometric stencil font across the chest. Below it, add the secondary text in white using a small, spaced-out italic serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text red and ultra-wide?
Is the background a desaturated cool grey-blue?
Is the subject wearing a black leather jacket and cowboy hat?
Is the lighting high-contrast with a hat shadow?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the display text
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Text is legible against the dark jacket
The hat shadow does not obscure the entire face
The red color is vibrant but not bleeding into the background
The wide tracking is consistent across the primary text line
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Portrait + Wide Geometric Display Text + High Contrast Lighting = Modern Western Aesthetic
